description:
Hushfeed v0.70.0 has 130 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Hushfeed v0.70.0 has 130 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically). 47.1.4 is the only supported version now, so patch that APK with your usual signing key.

Simple mode picks 107 patches, and their switches start off. Hushfeed settings open on a shorter home page with search. New switches hide the side menu button next to LIVE and Thoughts on profiles, keep offline videos until you delete them, and leave the languages you pick out of TikTok's automatic translation. Author text size covers the post date too. See the changelog for the full list.

Validation: 3618 runtime tests passed and 699 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 130 patches applied to the supported APK with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
